scripts.build:all: cd teacher && npm run prebuild && npx quasar build -m electron --skip-pkg && cd ../student && npm run prebuild && npx quasar build -m electron --skip-pkg
scripts.dev: npm exec --prefix teacher -- concurrently "npm --prefix teacher run dev" "npm exec --prefix student -- cross-env NXE_ELECTRON_INSPECT_PORT=5859 npm --prefix student run dev -- -p 9301"
scripts.dev:ios: npm exec --prefix teacher -- concurrently "npm --prefix teacher run dev" "npm exec --prefix student -- cross-env NXE_ELECTRON_INSPECT_PORT=5859 npm --prefix student run dev:ios -- -p 9301"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:all && npx playwright test e2e/*
scripts.install:dependencies: npm install && cd teacher && npm install && cd ../student && npm install
scripts.test:ios: cd student && npm run build:ios && cd .. && node e2e/capacitor-sprachen.mjs
